w2_boundary.meaning: A closed combinatorial 3-manifold triangulation of the actual post-2-handle boundary; not a homeomorphism_type label.

attaching_spheres.meaning: Pairwise vertex-disjoint triangular subcomplexes of w2_boundary, each checked as a connected closed surface of Euler characteristic two.

detector_ball.meaning: A tetrahedron subcomplex disjoint from all attaching spheres. shelling_order must give a checked shelling down to one tetrahedron.

normal_surgery_trace.semantics: parallel_vertex_map identifies a disjoint parallel copy of every sphere vertex. product_tetrahedra must equal the verifier-derived staircase triangulation of S2 x I. The verifier removes precisely these tetrahedra, appends the two cap vertices, cones both boundary sphere copies, and requires exact equality with result.
normal_surgery_trace.meaning: A replayable cut-open-and-cap trace deriving surgery_result from w2_boundary and the three sphere subcomplexes. No PASS receipt is accepted.

surgery_result.meaning: The derived closed triangulation, with either a replayable bistellar reduction or an explicit simplicial isomorphism to a fixed standard S3.

four_ball.meaning: An explicit combinatorial 4-ball whose boundary triangulation is derived by the verifier.

attaching_isomorphism.meaning: A vertex bijection carrying the derived boundary of four_ball tetrahedron-for-tetrahedron onto surgery_result.
